notes.drawing: Letters as in text-aa (the A's crossbar at 70 % of its height), 80 units tall and 72 wide, stacked with 32 between them; the arrow is sort-ascending's shaft and 40-unit head, run the full height. Both directions keep the arrow pointing down and swap the letters, so the icon reads top to bottom as A→Z or Z→A.
notes.fill: As arrows-vertical-fill: the arrowhead becomes a solid triangle, the letters stay lines (in a filled box, as sort-ascending-fill does, the A's counter closes up).
notes.duotone: Tints the square behind letters and arrow, cut along the arrowhead's right arm, as sort-ascending-duotone does.
notes.bold: The letters are 76 tall with 40 between them, and the A's crossbar sits at 79 % of its height: at full size the thicker strokes closed the A's counter and nearly joined the two letters.
